annotations.title: Quote a custom tab set price

description: Use this when the user wants a price for custom-printed tab dividers and knows the tabs per set and number of sets: returns exact per-set and total USD with setup included, plus an orderUrl that opens Tabzoola's configurator with this build pre-selected for a human to complete. Same engine as the website. Minimum 25 sets, 1-150 tabs per set. Do not use for reverse-printed tabs, PMS ink or custom sheet sizes (quote only), and never to charge anyone: it is read-only.

colorChanges.description: Optional and ignored for price: tab colors mix freely at no extra charge

options.description: Optional map of optionKey -> choiceId (see get_pricing_capabilities). Omitted options use defaults.

product.description: Product line (paper is the only product)
